verifier_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py). All five candidates confirmed in part 31 of ky_scope.json. Corrected: Crigler's office no longer says he was elected to the unexpired term in November 2019 (the 2019 article only announces that election; the Clerk's office page confirms he is the clerk today); Brown's website 'how' now states what the site itself shows rather than the Branch Politics link, which was not re-checked.
note: 30 candidates in this part. The session's shared web-search allowance ran out after eight searches for this part, and WebFetch could not resolve most hosts (kycourts.gov, wcpo.com, georgebrownky.com), so pages were read with the kit's own fetcher (states/net.py). Most county sites tried (Laurel, Shelby, Jessamine, Muhlenberg, Estill, Livingston, Allen, Trimble, Wolfe, Gallatin, Magoffin, Menifee) did not resolve or refused; the Pulaski PVA site answered 403. Nothing was found that could be read for the constables, magistrates, jailer, surveyor, the Allen and Magoffin county attorneys, the Pulaski PVA, the district judge, the Covington, Glasgow and Paris city candidates, or the three school-board candidates, so they are left out. Covington's own Mayor and Commission page does not list Jay Fossett, so no office is recorded for him. Lambert's birth year is given by Wikipedia only as '1961 or 1962', so none is recorded. Brown is a sitting legislator with a record page: only his website and own words are recorded. Brown's campaign site is the standing site of his House District 77 committee (its footer reads 'Copyright 2014'; its issues list mentions the 2020 Census); it names him and the office. Walters is on the Jefferson County Republican Party's 2026 candidate page, which does not say endorsed; that is already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json and is not repeated here.
